caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a brown finish. The tabletop is rectangular with rounded and scalloped edges, supported by a central, ornately carved pedestal. The pedestal transitions into four curved, splayed legs that each end in a brass or gold-colored caster wheel. The table stands on a plain, light beige background, bordered by a thin, hand-drawn line close to the paper's edge. In the lower-left corner, the name "Bernard Krieger" is written in cursive. The overall composition centers the table, leaving ample empty space around it.
title: Table (Pedestal)
